title: Oechsler on the news: Inman convinced him vehicles are non-human

tellings.quote:
Well, Admiral Inman convinced me
that uh these vehicles were uh not
manufactured by human technology. So
that's pretty conclusive for me.

plain: A UFO researcher named Bob Oechsler said in a news clip that a retired Navy admiral named Bobby Ray Inman had convinced him that certain craft were not built with human technology. Oechsler's words, shown on the show, were that Inman "convinced me that uh these vehicles were uh not manufactured by human technology," which for him was "pretty conclusive." He is repeating what he says Inman told him sometime between 1989 and 1999, and if true it would mean a senior military figure privately confirmed non-human craft.
